g_policy.reason: The offer copy 'Play a short game for a welcome-back surprise!' does not state the reward (3 Advanced reasoning answers until midnight) before the ad, so the copy condition in g_policy fails.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 3 Advanced reasoning mode answers until midnight, which is an in-app sample and has no cash value.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is the first app open after 3 or more days without a session, which is an app event and needs no chat content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The proposal removes nothing free ('removes nothing free: yes') and only adds a sample of a paywalled feature.

g_brand_safety.reason: The offer is a dismissible card on the Chats home (s01, rated safe), which counts as app chrome, and it is not inside a conversation.

c1_revealed_value.reason: Advanced reasoning mode is listed as a Luzia+ paywall bullet (l02, s02.e03), so the app charges for the resource the reward gives.

c2_evidence.reason: The claims about the app today are supported: the paywall lists Advanced reasoning mode, plans and trial (s02.e03, s02.e19), and the home has the upsell badge (s01.e02) and the 'How can I help you today?' prompt. The reward, the card and the revenue remarks are the proposal's own additions or predictions.

c3_spares_payers.reason: Subscribers are never shown the offer and the reward is a slice of their plan, so the offer is a sample for users who don't pay.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward is 3 answers that expire at midnight local time, so it is a sample that ends and does not give lasting access to the paid feature.

c5_moment.reason: The card appears at app open on the home screen, so it interrupts no task, and the user can dismiss it.

c6_fits_simula.reason: It is a play-to-earn sponsored game. The reward is granted only after the play is confirmed (a failed play shows 'That game didn't count'), and the trigger is a detectable app event (the first open after a gap of 3 or more days).

c7_specific.reason: It names Advanced reasoning mode (s02.e03), the Luzia+ badge on Chats home (s01.e02) and the 3-day trial button, so it is tied to this app.

other_concern: The 'surprise' wording hides the value. Making the reward explicit in the copy also helps the offer perform. Reward sizing for lower-earning markets is only a prediction.
